text:
alice: Heads up — staging APAC keystore replication failed during a maintenance toggle, several warm pool GPUs couldn't decrypt and stayed in join state.
tom: saw the alerts, 4 nodes marked 'decrypt_timeout' and were evicted by the autoscaler.
infra-bot: Incident INT-APAC-REPL-1749999990 created and paged infra/sre/security.
priya: onboarding blocked for ap-southeast-1 while HSM operator toggled FIPS. replication REST calls got 403 and some 5xx. logs show mirror account auth denied.
dan: immediate mitigation idea: open a short-lived privatelink route for the keystore replication CIDR (10.66.8.0/26) from staging subnets so keystore can push copies. need security approval and a PR for audit.
meera: approving temporary access only with: (1) SIEM ingestion enabled for that path, (2) an infra-repo PR with explicit revert timer, (3) a compliance note listing approver.
alice: I can draft the PR and the SIEM toggle. we'll limit to 20 minutes unless we extend.
tom: PR draft snippet (terraform):

```
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "keystore_temp_open" {
  type              = "ingress"
  from_port         = 443
  to_port           = 443
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = ["10.66.8.0/26"]
  security_group_id = var.keystore_pl_sg
  description       = "temporary allow for keystore replication from apac staging"
}
```

priya: add a tags map: { "change_ticket": "INT-APAC-REPL-1749999990", "approver": "meera" } so it surfaces in change tools.
dan: cost note — keeping drained GPUs replaced took ~30m, billing for 3 x g4dn.xlarge ~ $Y. if we let nodes sit longer, costs scale linearly. include a cost estimate in PR.
meera: approve PR with the tag and 20m timer. log the approval in the compliance tracker. also require key rotation if any key downloads happened during exception window.
alice: applying now on staging-privatelink. infra-bot will monitor replication success and warm pool health.
infra-bot: terraform apply started (staging-privatelink) — plan: 1 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.
meera: once replication resumes, we revert in 20m. make sure metrics for ``keystore.replication.success_rate`` and ``gpu.warmpool.join_latency`` are annotated.
tom: replication resumed ~55s after rule applied; three nodes finished decrypt and rejoined. warm pool at target.
dan: rolling timer set to revoke at TTL. if anything else pops, we'll extend with approval.
priya: filing follow-ups: - infra task: add retry/backoff for replication on auth failures - ops task: create an automated failover to eu model variant when apac keystore degraded - compliance task: store change log + approver + evidence in ticket.
meera: also request a post-incident runbook update: how to coordinate HSM toggles with keystore mirrors and warm pool onboarding.
alice: PR merged: https://git.company/infra/PR/1309 (includes ACL, tags, SIEM toggle, cost estimate). apply complete.
infra-bot: ACL rule removed after TTL expired (revoke executed) — 1 removed.
meera: good — confirm no unauthorized access in SIEM logs for window.
priya: quick SIEM check: we saw replication traffic only from the allowlisted CIDR, three successful pulls, no unexpected principals. will attach logs to the ticket.
dan: wrapping up cost calc and adding to the incident summary.
tom: recommend next steps: add synthetic keystore-replication check, make keystore client tolerant to transient 403 during FIPS toggles, and add a canary region flag for onboarding.
meera: assigning owners in ticket now. closing channel when postmortem is filed. thanks all :thumbsup:
